articles.title: Joel Habener, Whose Research Helped Develop Weight-Loss Drugs, Dies at 88
articles.mainIdea: Joel Habener, Whose Research Helped Develop Weight-Loss Drugs, Dies at 88
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Joel Habener, Whose Research Helped Develop Weight-Loss Drugs, Dies at 88. Joel F. Habener, a Harvard University academic whose research paved the way for revolutionary weight-loss drugs Ozempic, Mounjaro and others, which analysts forecast will be the biggest blockbusters in pharmaceutical history, died Sunday in Newton, Mass. He was 88. Eileen Martin, a friend of Habener’s, said he died peacefully at home. Habener led research that discovered a hormone dubbed GLP-1. Related tickers mentioned: NVO.
